overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets, for the current process, the minimum-value constraint of the number/date/time object(s) designated by object and *.

constraints: minValue's type must match the object's underlying data type, otherwise error 18 'Field types are incompatible' is generated.
